map.NAFLD专用阈值。LSM＜8 kPa排除显著纤维化（NPV＞90%），LSM＞: NAFLD-specific thresholds. LSM<8 kPa rules out significant fibrosis (NPV>90%), LSM>15 kPa diagnoses cirrhosis (PPV>80%). The 8-15 kPa range is a gray zone; combining with serum scores such as FIB-4/NAST is recommended.
map.CAP阈值因设备和探头略有差异。CAP可半定量评估肝脂肪变性，但不能区分脂肪性肝: CAP thresholds differ slightly by device and probe. CAP can semi-quantitatively assess hepatic steatosis but cannot distinguish steatohepatitis (NASH) from simple fatty liver (NAFL).
map.＜1.3：排除显著纤维化（NPV 90%），可观察: <1.3: rules out significant fibrosis (NPV 90%), observation is fine
map.＞2.67：提示显著纤维化，建议肝活检: >2.67: suggests significant fibrosis, liver biopsy recommended
map.提示：FibroScan是NAFLD无创评估的重要工具。LSM评估纤维化程度，C: Note: FibroScan is an important non-invasive assessment tool for NAFLD. LSM assesses fibrosis degree, CAP assesses steatosis degree. BMI>30 kg/m² suggests using the XL probe. ALT>5 times the upper limit of normal, cholestasis, and right heart failure can affect LSM accuracy. For clinical reference only.

map.纤维化分期：由 LSM(kPa) 定 F0-F4，区分是否肝硬化: Fibrosis staging: determine F0-F4 from LSM (kPa), distinguishing cirrhosis
map.脂肪变分级：由 CAP(dB/m) 定 S0-S3，指导减重与用药: Steatosis grading: determine S0-S3 from CAP (dB/m), guiding weight loss and medication
map.联合判断：LSM≥15 直接按 F4 管理，筛查静脉曲张与肝癌: Combined judgment: LSM≥15 is managed directly as F4, screening for varices and hepatocellular carcinoma
map.算法：LSM <8kPa → F0-F1（排除显著纤维化，NPV>90%）、8~: Algorithm: LSM <8kPa → F0-F1 (significant fibrosis ruled out, NPV>90%), 8~10 → F2, 10~15 → F3, ≥15kPa → F4 (cirrhosis); CAP <248 → S0, 248~269 → S1, 269~295 → S2, ≥295 dB/m → S3. AST/PLT >0.15 suggests FIB-4 may be elevated; complete calculation is recommended. When the measurement is invalid (IQR/median>0.3) the result is questionable and retesting is needed.
map.例：LSM 7.0kPa、CAP 240 dB/m → F0-F1（排除显著纤维: Example: LSM 7.0 kPa, CAP 240 dB/m → F0-F1 (significant fibrosis ruled out), S0 (no steatosis), low hepatic steatosis risk, health follow-up suffices. If LSM 18.0 kPa, CAP 310 dB/m → F4 (cirrhosis), S3 (severe steatosis); completing blood count/coagulation/ultrasound to assess complications, gastroscopy for varices, and ultrasound + AFP every 6 months for HCC screening are advised.
map.LSM 受什么影响会偏高？: What makes LSM read falsely high?
map.急性肝炎、肝淤血（右心衰）、胆汁淤积、进食后及肥胖者皮下脂肪厚均可使 LSM 假: Acute hepatitis, hepatic congestion (right heart failure), cholestasis, postprandial state, and thick subcutaneous fat in obesity can all falsely raise LSM; reliable results require ≥10 valid consecutive measurements on the same slice with IQR/median ≤0.3. When questionable, combine with FIB-4, APRI, and imaging.
map.CAP 能代替活检看脂肪变吗？: Can CAP replace biopsy for assessing steatosis?
map.CAP 无创反映肝脏脂肪变程度，与受控衰减参数一致好，但受探头部（M/XL）与炎: CAP non-invasively reflects the degree of hepatic steatosis and correlates well with controlled attenuation, but it is affected by the probe type (M/XL) and inflammation, and cannot replace biopsy assessment of inflammation and ballooning (NASH activity). S3 warrants active weight loss and metabolic management.
